input.quote: Sparkling shall pay the fees as set out in the Fee Schedule in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and the Fee Schedule.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no minimum purchase commitment, take-or-pay, shortfall or volume-commitment obligation on Sparkling. Searches for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall" and a review of Fees (§11), Maintenance and Support (§10), Grant of Licence (§2), Restrictions on Use (§3) and the Schedule list (Schedules A–F) return only fee-for-service and licence-scope terms: Sparkling pays the fees set out in the Fee Schedule, maintenance runs on a renewable one-year term, and additional fees arise only if Sparkling elects to use the Software beyond the Authorized Locations. The §3 restrictions are ordinary licence-scope limits (copying, sublicensing, reverse engineering), not caps on our purchasing or usage volumes. Exit is also unconstrained: under §17(b) Sparkling may terminate at any time on ninety (90) days' notice, so there is no multi-year locked-in spend. This meets the preferred position (no minimum commitment; fees for usage or ordered services only). Note only that pricing detail sits in Schedule "A" (Fee Schedule), which is not reproduced in the body — we should confirm on execution that it contains no committed licence counts or minimum maintenance years.
